items.body:
<details open>

model : limite: reject mudd configs that index past mudd_tap_idx on load (#32562)

n_mudd_taps comes from limite.mudd.tap_count, a scalar read separately
from the length-checked tap_indices array. mudd_tap_idx is a fixed
std::array<int32_t, 512> indexed at [i*n_taps] in both the tensor load
and the graph build, so a crafted GGUF with n_layer * n_mudd_taps > 512
reads past the array.

Reject that at hparams load; the one check covers both index sites.

</details>
